recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed unless a future PA decision changes the Endpoint payload advertising model or intentionally makes payload type mandatory again.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive PA change request for Endpoint asking to relax Endpoint.payloadType from 1..* to 0..* because FHIR REST and messaging endpoints may not have an appropriate payload type value and can rely on dynamic capability mechanisms; the resolution allows projects or jurisdictions to profile it as mandatory when needed.
initial_application: No standalone source commit specifically for FHIR-22629 was found. The requested cardinality relaxation was applied in commit 445d4741d1559c197decca8343f60d1cad753d36, which changed Endpoint.payloadType min from 1 to 0 as part of broader Endpoint cardinality work; merge commit 29c32a3f611f298e0601cd090b441155fed47286 explicitly lists FHIR-22629 among the Endpoint cardinality trackers addressed by PR #1832.
additional_context: Endpoint is active in source/fhir.ini. The old Endpoint.payloadType compatibility name maps to Endpoint.payload.type in source/fhir.ini, and later Endpoint payload refactors grouped payload details under Endpoint.payload without restoring mandatory payload type. Related Endpoint cardinality trackers FHIR-34261 and FHIR-25393 are already represented on the combined branch and support the same 0..* outcome.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change is required because source/endpoint/structuredefinition-Endpoint.xml already defines Endpoint.payload.type with min 0 and max *.
